name: plugin-diagnostics
description: Detects and reports why installed plugins cannot run: hooks that fail to launch, and missing runtimes or prerequisite tools.

hook_failure_audit_enabled.title: Hook-failure-audit hook
hook_failure_audit_enabled.description: Warns once per session per hook when the transcript records hook launch or exec failures Claude Code never surfaced. On by default.

stdin_read_timeout.title: Hook stdin read timeout (seconds)
stdin_read_timeout.description: Idle bound on reading the hook payload from stdin: how long the pipe may go silent before the hook gives up and fails open. Default 2.
